caption: The drawing depicts a female doll or figure with pale skin and short black hair. She is wearing a long, full red skirt and a matching red jacket, both decorated with small black and white cross-like patterns. The jacket has light grayish, fur-like cuffs and a black center panel. The figure is holding the sides of her skirt, lifting it to reveal a white, pleated underskirt and white bloomers with a purple ribbon on one leg. She is also wearing green shoes with small heels. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present. The drawing is signed "Edith Turner" in the bottom right corner.
title: Doll - "Mitio"
